dataset.citation: AstraZeneca, deposited data set (ChEMBL3301365); dataset via Therapeutics Data Commons (PPBR_AZ)
dataset.description: Human plasma protein binding measured by AstraZeneca and released through ChEMBL, expressed as the percentage of drug bound to plasma proteins.
dataset.endpoint: percentage of compound bound to human plasma proteins
dataset.name: plasma_protein_binding

label: Plasma protein binding (QSAR)
metric_summary: Scaffold-split held-out mean absolute error 8.2 % bound, R2 0.30 on 322 compounds sharing no scaffold with the training set (label standard deviation 16.7).

split.method: Bemis-Murcko scaffold split (largest scaffold groups held for training)
